_meta.purpose: Device Schema: define a device class (viewport, shell skeleton, interaction model).
_meta.scope: Device owns the app shell (sidebar+content+inspector vs header+content+bottom-action) and responsive policy. It shares Component/Content Model with other devices, but may use completely different Layout Patterns.
_meta.key_principle: PC and Mobile are NOT just CSS media queries. Same Content Model, different shell and layout pattern.
_meta.usage: Planner selects device first, then picks Layout Pattern + Template variant for that device.

viewport.max_width: max viewport width (px), null for unbounded

shell.structure: app frame skeleton, e.g. sidebar+content+inspector / header+content+bottom-action
shell.sider_width: sidebar width token, null if none

layout_policy.default_split: default split tier for split layouts
layout_policy.responsive_breakpoint: width where multi-column collapses to single

interaction_model.touch_target_min: min touch target size, null for mouse
